why: Makes the `frontier` mode build a snapshot live even when `--in` handed it one, which quietly turns #437's tokenless consumer into a token'd producer. It is not a performance nit: an anonymous live build FAILS at this repository's size (73 open issues exhaust the 60-per-hour unauthenticated budget partway through enrichment), so the mutation converts a command that works with no credentials at all into one that errors for anyone without a token. The test injects a `fetchImpl` that throws, so any request at all fails the run.
killedBy: frontier report reads a snapshot file and reaches no network at all
